## EffectAreaFile

EffectAreaFile configures static world effect areas and the global safe
destinations used by contaminated-area recovery logic.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 2 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EffectAreaFile.Areas

Key: `Areas`

Areas define the effect volumes, their script behavior, and optional visual
effects shown to players.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items reference | [`EffectArea`](#effectarea) (`#/$defs/EffectArea`) |

### EffectAreaFile.SafePositions

Key: `SafePositions`

SafePositions are global X/Z destination candidates used when a player connects
inside a contaminated area. The game selects the nearest point in 2D and derives
its Y coordinate from the terrain.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `array` |

| Properties | 5 |

| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |

Key: `TriggerType`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.`TriggerType`

| Attribute | Value |

### EffectArea.Type

Key: `Type`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.`Type`

## EffectAreaData

EffectAreaData defines the area's cylindrical bounds and the particle or
timed-effect parameters consumed by its script class.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `object` |
| Properties | 9 |
| Additional properties | boolean schema=false |

### EffectAreaData.EffectDuration

Key: `EffectDuration`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`EffectDuration`

EffectDuration is how long, in seconds, a recurring effect remains active for
area types that implement timed effects.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `180` |

### EffectAreaData.EffectInterval

Key: `EffectInterval`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`EffectInterval`

EffectInterval is the delay, in seconds, between recurring effects for area
types that implement timed effects.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `7200` |

### EffectAreaData.InnerPartDist

Key: `InnerPartDist`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`InnerPartDist`

InnerPartDist controls particle size when filling the area with emitters. The
1.28 configuration describes this setting as partSize.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `80` |

### EffectAreaData.NegHeight

Key: `NegHeight`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`NegHeight`

NegHeight is the distance in meters that the area extends below Pos.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `3` |

### EffectAreaData.OuterOffset

Key: `OuterOffset`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`OuterOffset`

OuterOffset extends visible particles beyond the configured area radius, in
meters.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `30` |

### EffectAreaData.ParticleName

Key: `ParticleName`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`ParticleName`

ParticleName is the resource path for particles emitted by the area.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `string` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `graphics/particles/contaminated_area_gas_bigass` |

### EffectAreaData.Pos

Key: `Pos`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`Pos`

Pos is the area's center or anchor in world X/Y/Z coordinates. It does not need
to be placed on the terrain surface.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `array` |
| Required | no |
| Items type | `number` |
| Constraints | `minItems=3`; `maxItems=3` |

### EffectAreaData.PosHeight

Key: `PosHeight`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`PosHeight`

PosHeight is the distance in meters that the area extends above Pos.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `20` |

### EffectAreaData.Radius

Key: `Radius`

Path: [`Areas`](#effectareafileareas).`[]`.[`Data`](#effectareaeffectareadata).`Radius`

Radius is the horizontal radius of the area in meters. The game skips the area
when this value is zero or negative.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `number` |
| Required | no |
| Examples | `75` |
